statements.name: schema 1
statements.sql:
CREATE TABLE customers (
  customer_id text PRIMARY KEY,
  name text NOT NULL
)

statements.name: schema 2
statements.sql:
CREATE TABLE products (
  product_id text PRIMARY KEY,
  name text NOT NULL,
  current_price numeric(12,2) NOT NULL
    CHECK (current_price >= 0 AND current_price <> 'NaN'::numeric),
  sku text UNIQUE
)

statements.name: schema 3
statements.sql:
CREATE TABLE orders (
  order_id text PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id text NOT NULL
    REFERENCES customers (customer_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  placed_at timestamptz NOT NULL
)

statements.name: schema 4
statements.sql:
CREATE TABLE order_lines (
  order_id text NOT NULL
    REFERENCES orders (order_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  line_no integer NOT NULL CHECK (line_no > 0),
  product_id text NOT NULL
    REFERENCES products (product_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  quantity integer NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
  unit_price numeric(12,2) NOT NULL
    CHECK (unit_price >= 0 AND unit_price <> 'NaN'::numeric),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, line_no)
)

statements.sql:
SELECT l.line_no, p.name, l.quantity,
       l.unit_price, l.quantity * l.unit_price AS line_total
FROM order_lines AS l
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE l.order_id = 'O12'
ORDER BY l.line_no;

statements.name: valuesQuery
statements.sql:
WITH samples (label, attributes) AS (
  VALUES
    ('missing key', '{}'::jsonb),
    ('JSON null', '{"capacity_ml":null}'::jsonb),
    ('number', '{"capacity_ml":350}'::jsonb),
    ('string', '{"capacity_ml":"350"}'::jsonb),
    ('SQL NULL', NULL::jsonb)
)
SELECT label,
       attributes ? 'capacity_ml' AS has_key,
       jsonb_typeof(attributes -> 'capacity_ml') AS json_type,
       attributes ->> 'capacity_ml' AS text_value
FROM samples;

statements.name: jsonQuery before changing capacity
statements.sql:
SELECT product_id, name,
       (attributes ->> 'capacity_ml')::integer AS capacity_ml
FROM products
WHERE attributes @> '{"material":"ceramic"}'::jsonb
  AND (attributes ->> 'capacity_ml')::integer >= 300;

statements.name: typeCheck 1

ADD CONSTRAINT capacity_is_number
CHECK (
  NOT (attributes ? 'capacity_ml')
  OR jsonb_typeof(attributes -> 'capacity_ml') = 'number'
)
